title: Monkey
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 68 Q88 65 86 48 Q84 38 76 40" fill="none" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail lighter edge -->
  <path d="M72 68 Q88 65 86 48 Q84 38 76 40" fill="none" stroke="#C46A1A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- body belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#D4A574"/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="68" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#8B4513" transform="rotate(20 30 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="68" rx="3" ry="8" fill="#A0522D" transform="rotate(20 30 68)"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="68" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#8B4513" transform="rotate(-20 70 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="68" rx="3" ry="8" fill="#A0522D" transform="rotate(-20 70 68)"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="90" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="90" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="90" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="90" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="24" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="34" r="10" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="34" r="6" fill="#D4A574"/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="34" r="10" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="34" r="6" fill="#D4A574"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#D4A574"/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="4.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="1.8" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="4.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="37" r="1.8" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <!-- left nostril -->
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="48" r="1" fill="#3A1A00"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 53 Q50 58 56 53" fill="none" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- mouth highlight -->
  <path d="M45 53 Q50 56 55 53" fill="none" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
